display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
┌─────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Scale │ Problem │
├─────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1K wps │ Works fine │
│ 10K wps │ Single flusher is bottleneck. Dirty buffer grows │
│ 50K wps │ Memory pressure: dirty buffer > 50% of heap │
│ 100K wps│ Flush backlog: 500K+ entries, latency spikes │
│ 500K wps│ OOM crash. Data loss on restart. No WAL. │
│ Failover│ Single point of failure. No replicas. │
│ Network │ Single DB connection. Flush blocks on DB latency │
└─────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
